model_card_claims.description: Multilingual operational classification model; candidate labels are supplied at call time; single-label and multi-label classification are supported.
model_card_claims.model_card_warning: Not a general-purpose model; it does not reason, explain, or answer open questions.
model_card_claims.benchmark: 56.7% average exact-match on fastino/fast-decisions, an English suite with 17 domains and 300 held-out examples per domain. The model card recommends GLiNER2.5-Decide for English-only input and this multi variant for multilingual input. This is not a SKU-matching benchmark.

suitability_assessment.plausible_trial: Pairwise classification with caller-supplied labels such as same SKU, different SKU, and needs review; potentially classify normalized attributes if the schema is predefined.
suitability_assessment.not_a_drop_in_embedding_model: The documented Decide interface returns class labels for an input and label set. It does not produce the reusable 384-dimensional text vectors used by MiniLM nearest-neighbor ranking. Compare it as a pairwise classifier or reranker, not as a vector embedding model.
suitability_assessment.attribute_extraction_caveat: The card describes classification and schema-driven extraction, but it does not establish that this Decide checkpoint extracts arbitrary Japanese width, height, color, lace, or piece-count spans accurately. Test extraction separately; do not assume classification labels are canonical extracted values.
unknowns: No published Japanese curtain SKU matching result was found on the official card.
No CPU throughput, peak RSS, quantization, or runtime guarantee is published on the card.
The 1,166,145,155-byte API storage figure is repository storage, not a measured resident-memory requirement.
suitability_assessment.recommendation: Keep it as a classification candidate for a small, controlled CPU evaluation. Do not install or download the 1.17 GB repository artifact as part of this reference check; select and run it only in the separate model-selection session if its runtime cost fits the stated limits.
